IMPLEMENTED SCOPE
Settings has one camera connection with Wi-Fi / USB choices. Redundant
preset-import transport and wireless-address sections are removed. Preset
detail uses the actual connected transport. With no connection, it retains
the selected preset and resumes capability / slot checks after connection;
the user must still explicitly confirm before any camera write.
Camera details offers manual preset-support checking. Wi-Fi host / port
and drafts share persistent preferences with migration of the old keys.
Opening a Wi-Fi session reads identity without enumerating storage/photos;
photo inventory is prepared only when the album destination is opened.
An unavailable photo inventory does not prevent independent preset checks.
Existing target, overwrite, uncertainty and readback checks are retained.

= 1,209 checks. Controller coverage adds 52 checks in this change.
Photo download, date grouping, deletion and preset rendering are unchanged;
their prior-version test results are not counted as new runs here.

FINAL ARTIFACT: ANDROID 17 EMULATOR / LOOPBACK SYNTHETIC CAMERA
Initial Settings connect performs GetDeviceInfo (0x1001) and OpenSession
(0x1002), no GetStorageIDs (0x1004) or GetObjectHandles (0x1007).
Camera details checks preset support on demand and reports eight empty slots.
Opening a preset's import confirmation does not create another handshake
or issue a write. Backing out before connection returns to that preset.
After explicit disconnect, the synthetic AP refuses a new connection;
restarting that local test AP and retrying returns automatically to the
original PreviewTone C2 confirmation. No automatic write occurs.
Explicit confirmation performs one virtual 614-byte registration and
successful readback. Opening Album afterwards shows 24+ photos and
thumbnails over the same Init/Open session used for the successful import.
